visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a clean white background featuring the large orange numbers 2026 stacked vertically. At the bottom, an animated orange tabby cat wearing a small yellow party hat smiles with closed eyes while emerging from a yellow and red party popper cone. The cat holds a small golden scroll with Japanese text. (2) In a swift motion, the animated cat character slides vertically downward, disappearing completely into the opening of the yellow party popper cone. The screen remains focused on the static 2026 text against the white background as the character prepares for a sudden visual re-emergence from the bottom frame. (3) The yellow party popper cone tilts at an angle and then ejects the cat character upward with a burst of multi-colored confetti particles including yellow, green, and pink circles. The cat appears with a wide-open mouth, expressing excitement, as it pops back into the center of the frame. (4) The cat lands in a stable position while holding a golden scroll that now displays the English text HAPPY NEW YEAR in bold letters. The large orange 2026 text remains in the background, and the animation settles into a joyful, celebratory state with confetti still floating around.

The tempo is brisk and energetic, establishing an immediate atmosphere of joy and festivity without any human speech or background environmental noise floor. This acoustic transient marks the character's descent and is tightly synchronized with the visual motion, while the upbeat brass instrumentation continues to play steadily. (3) A distinct, percussive pop sound effect triggers, followed immediately by a layer of synthesized cheering and applause from a high-arousal crowd. The acoustic energy peaks as the brass music swells in volume, creating a sense of triumphant celebration and excitement in the mix. (4) The energetic celebratory music continues as the primary layer, maintaining its fast BPM and bright spectral brightness. The cheering sound effects fade out gradually, leaving the brass instruments to carry the upbeat melody to a clean conclusion as the short animation loop finishes.
